content.text: After 8 years: "נשאר בידיים 68,853". I put in 48,000. For 4 years it says nothing for self-employed. I'll stop here.

input.answer: If I put in 500 ₪ a month, after 8 years the calculator says about 68,853 ₪ "נשאר בידיים" (I would have paid in 48,000). For 4 years it gives no number at all. It says "לעצמאים עוד אין כאן חישוב למשיכה לפני 6 שנים", only that you pay tax.

stuck.why: There was no calculator on it. I had to guess that the 'מה קורה לכסף בקרן' tab was where it was
I wanted 4 years and the bars were empty. The orange sentence explains that there is no calculation for the self-employed before 6 years, so I got no number for 4 years
The year is set with a slider, which I avoid. I pressed the number 8 under the chart instead, and that worked

used: Orange note about withdrawing before 6 years
skimmed: The opening explanation 'מה זה' (only that you can take it out without tax after 6 years)
skipped: The sentence about return and inflation at the bottom
The 'שווה לדעת' and 'מי מציע ומי מצטרף' tabs
unsure_meaning: תשואה 7% (I don't know if that is realistic, I left it)
Underlines that are dotted or dashed under numbers
not_found: An amount for withdrawing after 4 years for the self-employed

findings.what: For the self-employed there is no result at all for fewer than 6 years. The bars are just empty, and only a small orange sentence explains why
The page is dark with light text. It is hard on the eyes, and the grey text under the chart is pale
There are many numbers with plus signs and bars in close colours (two greens, two yellows), and it's hard to tell what each one is
The year is chosen with a slider. You can tap the number, but the page doesn't say so clearly
The calculator isn't on the first screen, so you have to guess which tab has it
'S&P 500' and 'מסלול מדד' show up with no explanation
